## Read associations
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(qqman)

gemma_res <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blup_overall_ddm1_average/rank_transform/with_K/average_ddm1_ranktr_maf005.assoc.txt" ,header=T)
gemma_res$r_squared <- 2*gemma_res$af * (1-gemma_res$af)* gemma_res$beta^2

N <- 230

gemma_res$pve <- (2 * gemma_res$beta^2 * gemma_res$af * (1 - gemma_res$af)) / 
                 (2 * gemma_res$beta^2 * gemma_res$af * (1 - gemma_res$af) + 
                  gemma_res$se^2 * 2 * N * gemma_res$af * (1 - gemma_res$af))
```

```{r}
bonferroni_threshold <- 0.05/nrow(gemma_res)
par(mar = c(5, 5, 2, 2))  # Adjust margins to give more space
qq(gemma_res$p_wald, 
   cex.axis = 2, 
   cex.lab = 2)


par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))  # Increase left margin (second value)
manhattan(gemma_res, chr = "chr", bp = "ps", snp = "rs", p = "p_wald", 
         col = c("#1A1A1A", "#838B8B"), genomewideline = F, suggestiveline = F,
         ylim = c(0, 10), cex.axis = 2, cex.lab = 1.8,
         xlab = "Chromosome", ylab = expression(-log[10](P)))
abline(h = 7.5, col = "red", lty = 2)
abline(h = -log10(bonferroni_threshold), col = "black", lty = 2)
#text(x = 3, y = 11, labels = "F1 ddm1 BLUPs - F1 Col BLUPs,st values;LTR_Copia", cex = 1.5, col = "black", pos = 4)

gemma_res[order(-log10(gemma_res$p_wald), na.last = TRUE,decreasing = TRUE), ]
```

## Map to the gene 
```{r}
tes_tari10 <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_genes_transposons.gtf")
genes <- tes_tari10 %>% select(V1,V3,V4,V5,V9)
colnames(genes) <-c("chromosome_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "start_position","end_position", "description")
# Get gene id 
# Extract the ID part after "ID=" and before the first semicolon
genes$chromosome_name <- gsub("Chr", "",genes$chromosome_name)
genes$chromosome_name <- as.numeric(genes$chromosome_name)
```
## Annotate SNPs with genes
```{r}

peak_snps <- gemma_res %>%
  filter(chr == 5,
         ps >= 847439 - 100000,
         ps <= 847439 + 100000) %>%
  mutate(neg_log10_P = -log10(p_wald))

setDT(peak_snps)
setDT(genes)

peak_snps[, `:=`(start = ps, end = ps)]
setkey(genes, chromosome_name, start_position, end_position)

# Find overlaps with genes and SNPs 
snps_annotated <- foverlaps(
  peak_snps[, .(rs, chr, ps, p_wald, beta, pve, neg_log10_P, start, end,af)],
  genes[chromosome_name == 5 & 
        start_position <= 847439 + 100000 & 
        end_position   >= 847439 - 100000,
        .(chromosome_name, start_position, end_position, description)],
  by.x = c("chr", "start", "end"),
  by.y = c("chromosome_name", "start_position", "end_position"),
  type = "within",
  nomatch = NA
)
snps_annotated <- na.omit(snps_annotated) 
```
## Get gene labels filtered 
```{r}
# Add gene label
snps_annotated <- snps_annotated %>%
  mutate(gene_id = sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', "\\1", description),
         gene_id = ifelse(is.na(description), "intergenic", gene_id))

lead_per_gene <- snps_annotated %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(pve)) %>%
  select(gene_id, rs, ps, p_wald, neg_log10_P, beta, pve,af)

lead_per_gene <- lead_per_gene[lead_per_gene$neg_log10_P>4,]
lead_per_gene <- unique(lead_per_gene)
write.csv2(lead_per_gene,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/peaks_chr5_rank_expression_phenotype.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```





## Show the impact of the genes in the region
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

peak_chr   <- 5
peak_start <- 847439 - 100000
peak_end   <- 847439 + 100000

# ── 2. Get all SNPs in the peak with effect sizes ────────────────────────────
peak_snps <- gemma_res %>%
  filter(chr == peak_chr,
         ps >= peak_start,
         ps <= peak_end) %>%
  mutate(neg_log10_P = -log10(p_wald))

# ── 3. Get all genes in the peak window ──────────────────────────────────────
peak_genes <- genes %>%
  filter(chromosome_name == peak_chr,
         start_position <= peak_end,
         end_position   >= peak_start)

# ── 4. For each gene, find the lead SNP (lowest p-value) ─────────────────────
setDT(peak_snps)
setDT(peak_genes)

peak_snps[, `:=`(start = ps, end = ps)]
setkey(peak_genes, chromosome_name, start_position, end_position)

snps_annotated <- foverlaps(
  peak_snps[, .(rs, chr, ps, p_wald, beta, se, pve, neg_log10_P, start, end)],
  peak_genes[, .(chromosome_name, start_position, end_position, description)],
  by.x = c("chr", "start", "end"),
  by.y = c("chromosome_name", "start_position", "end_position"),
  type = "within",
  nomatch = NA
)

# ── 5. Lead SNP per gene ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lead_per_gene <- snps_annotated %>%
  group_by(description) %>%
  slice_min(p_wald, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(p_wald) %>%
  select(description, rs, ps, p_wald, neg_log10_P, beta, pve)

print(lead_per_gene, n = 50)
```

## ### Enrichment ###

## Enrichment 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

# ============================================
# 1. PREPARE SNP DATA
# ============================================
gemma_res$rs <- paste0("rs", gemma_res$ps, "_", gemma_res$chr)

region_start <- 5197151 - 50000
region_end <- 5197151 + 50000

res <- gemma_res %>% 
  filter(chr == 5, 
         ps >= region_start, 
         ps <= region_end) %>%
  select(rs, chr, ps, p_wald) %>%
  rename(SNP = rs, CHR = chr, BP = ps, P = p_wald)
# Optional: Manhattan plot
# manhattan(res, cex = 1, suggestiveline = 7.5, genomewideline = FALSE,
#           xlim = c(10957887 - 50000, 10957887 + 50000))

# ============================================
# 2. LOAD GENE ANNOTATIONS
# ============================================
gff <- fread("/groups/nordborg/common_data/TAIR10/TAIR10_gff3/TAIR10_GFF3_genes.gff")

gene_coords <- gff[V3 == "gene", .(
  gene_id = gsub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", V9),
  chr = as.integer(gsub("Chr", "", V1)),
  start = V4,
  end = V5
)]

# ============================================
# 3. LOAD A PRIORI GENES
# ============================================
apriori_genes <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/a_priori.genes.txt",
                       col.names = c("gene", "tair_id"))

apriori_genes <- apriori_genes %>%
  inner_join(gene_coords, by = c("tair_id" = "gene_id"))

# ============================================
# 4. DEFINE PEAK REGIONS
# ============================================
window_size <- 0

peak_regions <- res %>%
  mutate(
    peak_start = pmax(region_start, BP - window_size),
    peak_end = pmin(region_end, BP + window_size)
  )

# ============================================
# 5. FIND GENES IN PEAKS
# ============================================
# Helper function to check overlap
overlaps <- function(gene_start, gene_end, peak_start, peak_end) {
  gene_start <= peak_end & gene_end >= peak_start
}

genes_in_peaks <- gene_coords %>%
  inner_join(peak_regions, by = c("chr" = "CHR")) %>%
  filter(overlaps(start, end, peak_start, peak_end)) %>%
  pull(gene_id) %>%
  unique()

apriori_in_peaks <- apriori_genes %>%
  inner_join(peak_regions, by = c("chr"="CHR")) %>%
  filter(overlaps(start, end, peak_start, peak_end))

# ============================================
# 6. FISHER'S EXACT TEST
# ============================================
a <- sum(apriori_genes$tair_id %in% genes_in_peaks)  # A priori in peak
b <- nrow(apriori_genes) - a                          # A priori not in peak
c <- length(genes_in_peaks) - a                       # Other genes in peak
d <- nrow(gene_coords) - length(genes_in_peaks) - b  # Other genes not in peak

contingency <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2,
                     dimnames = list(c("A priori", "Other"),
                                   c("In peak", "Not in peak")))

fisher_result <- fisher.test(contingency, alternative = "greater")

# ============================================
# 7. RESULTS
# ============================================
cat("\n=== CONTINGENCY TABLE ===\n")
print(contingency)

cat("\n=== ENRICHMENT RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Total genes:", nrow(gene_coords), "\n")
cat("Genes in peaks:", length(genes_in_peaks), "\n")
cat("A priori genes in peaks:", a, "/", nrow(apriori_genes), "\n")
cat("Fold enrichment:", round(a / ((nrow(apriori_genes) / nrow(gene_coords)) * length(genes_in_peaks)), 2), "×\n")
cat("P-value:", format.pval(fisher_result$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
cat(ifelse(fisher_result$p.value < 0.05, "\n✓ SIGNIFICANT", "\n✗ NOT SIGNIFICANT"), "\n")

if(nrow(apriori_in_peaks) > 0) {
  cat("\nA priori genes found:\n")
  print(apriori_in_peaks[, .(gene, tair_id, chr, start, end)])
}
```

## Get genes under the peak 
```{r}
# Ensure variables are defined
max_upstream_distance <- 1  # Example value
max_downstream_distance <- 1  # Example value
# Initialize the list
snps_near_genes <- list()
# Ensure consistent data types
gemma_res$p_wald <- as.numeric(gemma_res$p_wald)
significant_snps <- gemma_res[-log10(gemma_res$p_wald)>5,]
#significant_snps <-filtered_data
significant_snps$chr <- as.numeric(significant_snps$chr)
genes_tair10$chr <- as.numeric(genes_tair10$chr)

# Loop through each SNP
for (i in 1:nrow(significant_snps)) {
  snp <- significant_snps[i, ]
  # Filter genes on the same chromosome
  genes_on_chr <- genes_tair10[genes_tair10$chr == snp$chr, ]
  
  # Check if genes_on_chr is not empty
  if (nrow(genes_on_chr) > 0) {
    # Check if SNP is near or inside a gene
    is_near_or_inside_gene <- (genes_on_chr$start - max_upstream_distance <= snp$ps & snp$ps <= genes_on_chr$stop + max_downstream_distance) |
      (genes_on_chr$start <= snp$ps & snp$ps <= genes_on_chr$stop)
    
    if (any(is_near_or_inside_gene)) {
      # Extract relevant genes
      temp_df <- genes_on_chr[is_near_or_inside_gene, ]
      temp_df$snp_position <- snp$ps
      temp_df$chromosome <- snp$chr
      temp_df$af <- snp$af
      temp_df$variance_explained <- snp$r_squared
      temp_df$pval <- ifelse(snp$p_wald > 0, -log10(snp$p_wald), NA)
      
      # Add to the list
      snps_near_genes[[i]] <- temp_df
    } else {
      snps_near_genes[[i]] <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    snps_near_genes[[i]] <- NULL
  }
}

# Combine all non-NULL data frames into a single data frame
snps_near_genes_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(snps_near_genes, function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)  # Skip NULL elements
  df
}))

snps_near_genes_df <- unique(snps_near_genes_df)
snps_near_genes_df <-snps_near_genes_df[snps_near_genes_df$chr==4,]
#write.table(snps_near_genes_df, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/log2_mean_centered_col0def_270acc_f1ddm1/output/significant_snps1kb_fromgene.csv", quote = F, sep="\t", row.names = F)
```

```{r}
## Intersect with CMT2
```

## Select genes of intereset 
```{r}
significance_threshold <- 4 ## Needs to be adjusted 
significant_snps <- gemma_res[(-log10(gemma_res$p_wald)) >significance_threshold, ]
head(significant_snps)
#significant_snps <-significant_snps[significant_snps$chr=="4", ]
```
## Map SNPs to the genes 
```{r}
max_upstream_distance <- 100  # Adjust as necessary
max_downstream_distance <- 100  # Adjust as necessary
snps_near_genes <- vector("list", length = nrow(significant_snps))
# Loop through each SNP to find if it's inside, upstream, or downstream of any gene
for (i in 1:nrow(significant_snps)) {
  snp <- significant_snps[i, ]
  genes_on_chr <- annotation_tair10[annotation_tair10$chromosome_name == snp$chr, ]
  is_near_or_inside_gene <- (genes_on_chr$start_position - max_upstream_distance <= snp$ps & snp$ps <= genes_on_chr$end_position + max_downstream_distance) |
    (genes_on_chr$start_position <= snp$ps & snp$ps <= genes_on_chr$end_position)
  
  if (any(is_near_or_inside_gene)) {
    temp_df <- genes_on_chr[is_near_or_inside_gene, ]
    temp_df$snp_position <- snp$ps
    temp_df$chromosome <- snp$chr 
    temp_df$af <- snp$af
    temp_df$variance_explained <- snp$r_squared
    temp_df$pval <- -log10(snp$p_wald)
    snps_near_genes[[i]] <- temp_df
  } else {
    snps_near_genes[[i]] <- NULL
  }
}

snps_near_genes_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(snps_near_genes, function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  df
}))


snps_near_genes_df$description <- NULL
```

```{r}
# Run PCA
pca <- snpgdsPCA(genofile, num.thread = 2, autosome.only = FALSE)

# Remove NA values from eigenvalues
eigenvals_clean <- pca$eigenval[!is.na(pca$eigenval)]

# Calculate percentage variance explained (using only non-NA eigenvalues)
percent_var <- (eigenvals_clean / sum(eigenvals_clean)) * 100
# Extract PCA results
pca_scores <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$eigenvect[,1],
  PC2 = pca$eigenvect[,2],
  Sample = pca$sample.id
)

metainformation$accession.ID <- as.numeric(metainformation$accession.ID )
pca_scores$Sample <- as.numeric(pca_scores$Sample)

pca_scores_with_metainfo <- inner_join(metainformation,pca_scores, by=c("accession.ID"="Sample"))
pca_scores_with_metainfo_phenotype <- inner_join(phenotype_sum,pca_scores_with_metainfo, by=c("sample"="accession.ID"))

sampleData = read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/filtered_data_wo_misclustered_2_repl.txt", header=T)

pca_scores_with_metainfo_phenotype_sampledata <- inner_join(pca_scores_with_metainfo_phenotype,sampleData, by=c("sample"="Accession"))
ggplot(pca_scores_with_metainfo_phenotype_sampledata, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color=Sequencing_date)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.2f%%)", percent_var[1]),  # Variance for PC1
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.2f%%)", percent_var[2]),  # Variance for PC2
    title = "PCA with Variance Explained"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
